gaps.sentence: This is ___ second time you've been late this week.
She has ___ excellent command of Japanese.
gaps.explanation: 'Have an excellent command of' — 'excellent' starts with a vowel sound.

gaps.sentence: ___ bicycles are a cheap way of seeing the city.
gaps.explanation: Plural nouns in a general sense take no article.

gaps.sentence: His wife goes to ___ prison every Sunday to visit him.
gaps.explanation: Here 'the prison' is the building she visits, not the institution of imprisonment.

gaps.sentence: ___ Sahara is expanding southwards by several kilometres a year.
gaps.explanation: Desert names take 'the': the Sahara, the Kalahari.

gaps.sentence: He had ___ operation on his knee last year.
gaps.explanation: 'Operation' starts with a vowel sound, so 'an operation'.

gaps.sentence: ___ rich often object to paying inheritance tax.
gaps.explanation: 'The rich' = rich people as a group.

gaps.sentence: He received ___ OBE in the New Year's Honours list.
gaps.explanation: 'OBE' is pronounced /əʊ biː iː/, starting with a vowel sound, so 'an' is used.
